newsitem.title: USA: Carson Pirie Feb sales above expectations.
newsitem.headline: Carson Pirie Feb sales above expectations.

text.p: Carson Pirie Scott & Co said Thursday its sales for February were above expectations.
As reported earlier this week, Carson's same store sales rose 8.2 percent for February, while total sales for the month gained 13.2 percent to $69.0 million.

"The February sales gains were broad based, coming across all merchandise categories and from nearly every store in the chain," Stanton Bluestone, chairman, said in a statement. "I was particularly pleased with the strong initial sell-through on new spring receipts during the month."
Carson operates 53 department stores and four furniture stores.
